title: Remove Duplicates
statement:
Build a new list that keeps each number only once, in the order it first shows up.

The first line is a whole number `n`, at least 1. The second line holds `n` integers separated by spaces. Print the numbers with every repeat removed, keeping the first time each one appears, on one line separated by single spaces. Start from an empty list and add to it as you go. The list can hold a single number, every number can be the same, or there can be no repeats at all.

Input:

```text
8
4 2 4 7 2 9 7 4
```

Expected output:

```text
4 2 7 9
```
hints: Start with an empty result list and go through the input one number at a time.
Before adding a number, check whether the result list already holds it.
